name: assembly-newsh4-195
summary: Bronze boss arm, 168 x 28 px from seven 2x2 pieces, reaching out to the right: a thick polished bronze upper arm (a round tube with a dark underside below it ending in a slanted, bright-rimmed edge), a narrow neck into a big bronze ball joint, a long round forearm ringed by a grey metal collar and a bright rib, a grey-brown box and a grey block mounted on top, and a tapering horn-like claw that curves down to a point with two small grey clamps on it. Shape language: round, metallic bronze tubes and a ball (each about as tall as it is wide), with small hard chamfered grey boxes and clamps on them; the claw tapers in width and height to its tip.

traits: a bronze ball about 17 px across (cols 35-52, rows 1-17) with a smaller darker lobe under it (rows 14-20)
a sphere: about as tall as it is wide (12 px or more), not a lens
its bright spots (col 43 row 3, col 40 row 7) are sheen, not bumps
features.note: The elbow: the baseline script's 'ball joint on a narrow neck'.

traits: a round bronze tube about 12 px wide (rows 1-13), cut off at the left edge, rounded at its right end (cols 26-32)
round profile: about as tall as it is wide (10-12 px), one mid bronze tone, metallic
the bright streak along rows 3-5 is the lit top of the cylinder, not a separate strip
a dark bronze lower tube under the upper arm (rows 13-21), lower than the upper arm
its right end slanted along the diagonal from (29, 21) to (35, 14), with a bright rim along that edge
features.note: The baseline's 'dark underside'; reads as a second, shadowed member of the upper arm.

traits: a narrower round neck joining the upper arm to the ball (cols 30-37)
lower and narrower than both the arm and the ball, so the joint pinches in
features.note: The narrow neck the ball joint sits on.

traits: a long round bronze tube about 10 px wide (rows 1-10) running from the ball to the claw
round: about as tall as wide (8-10 px), constant diameter, smooth metallic bronze
a lighter rail along its lower side (rows 11-12), widening at its root over the ball
a grey metal ring around the forearm (cols 57-65): bright grey above, dark below
stands proud of the forearm all round, crisp ends
a bright bronze rib ring right beside it (col 66)
features.note: The baseline's 'grey metal collar and a bright rib'.

traits: a tapering horn-like claw that curves down to a point at about (165, 25)
its width and height both shrink steadily to the tip, round in section
darker bronze than the forearm, with light edge lines along its length (edges catching the light)
features.note: The claw (newsh4-191, -193, -195), the reach of the arm.

traits: a grey-brown box on top of the forearm (cols 76-82, rows 1-6) with a strut down its right side to the rail
a grey block beside it (cols 84-89, rows 2-7)
hard, chamfered boxes standing clearly above the forearm's top, not painted on
two small grey clamps on the claw (cols 105-111 rows 4-8, cols 124-129 rows 7-11)
each a raised, chamfered block wrapped on the claw with a bright bronze rib ring behind it
features.note: The baseline's 'two small grey clamps on it'.
